text:
Which statement about alpha, beta and gamma radiation is not correct?
A
Alpha particles are deflected most in an electric field.
B
Beta particles are deflected most in a magnetic field.
C
Gamma radiation is not deflected by a magnetic field.
D
Gamma radiation is least ionising.

options.label: A
options.text: Alpha particles are deflected most in an electric field.

options.label: B
options.text: Beta particles are deflected most in a magnetic field.

options.label: C
options.text: Gamma radiation is not deflected by a magnetic field.

subject: Physics
